We would appreciate editorial help with six related Last Call PRs for the titled-asset ERC family. Each has completed its Review period and has a proposed Last Call deadline of 5 October.

[Asset Anchor Registry — ERC-8325, PR 2019](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2019)

[Canonical Document Bundle Anchor — ERC-8326, PR 2020](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2020)

[Directional Transfer Domain Registry — ERC-8327, PR 2021](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2021)

[Subject-Linked Compliance Event Log — ERC-8328, PR 2022](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2022)

[Subject-Linked Impact Snapshot Log — ERC-8329, PR 2023](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2023)

[Subject-Linked NAV Snapshot Oracle — ERC-8330, PR 2024](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2024)

They are independently usable, with optional composition across a titled-asset deployment. Thanks for any editorial help.
